question: Does a useful triangle grain capability need distribution substitution alongside retained seeded points, and does it transfer to existing region geometry?
decision: Compare distributions before choosing public sampling boundary; no public defaults or ranges authorized.
decision_rules: If uniform and source-biased coverage visibly differ, preserve their semantic distinction; do not claim uniform sampling reproduces active source grain.
Retain a public batch proposal only if the example avoids repetitive RNG/buffering glue and permits content substitution.
Keep source-specific brightness and triangulation outside sampling unless a demonstrated transfer requires them.
Treat colour/opacity change as one styling substitution, not isolated parameter evidence.
hypothesis: Uniform coverage, first-vertex concentration and biased second-coordinate coverage differ materially; appearance edits and rectangle transfer can consume the same point boundary.

parameter.name: distribution, density and independent content substitution

variants.change: Active puntis product before square root; same geometry/count/style
Active puntis3 coordinate distribution; same geometry/count/style, brightness discarded
Uniform density 0.1 to 0.2; same triangle and point stream prefix
Same retained uniform points; coral at alpha150 instead of teal at alpha90
Same retained uniform centres; horizontal length4 strokes instead of points
CP4 R4 cells split into 26 supplied triangles; same area-count/content mechanism

comparison: Native numeric checks plus all seven directly inspected PNGs; normalized RGB mean absolute difference and changed pixel fraction, no post-hoc numeric visual threshold.
constraints: No source image or private prior experiment rerender.
Private Java Random stream is not a public contract or source-pixel promise.
Shape/style choices are exploratory; no continuous encouraged range.
Biased modes preserve source draw order but use the same rendered ink to isolate spatial distribution.
Stroke centres are sampled inside; full strokes may cross triangle boundaries.
One serialized Processing process and one reserved attempt; preserve failures and partial output.
